summary.zh-CN: 按七个阶段开发功能：读懂现有代码、提出澄清问题、比较实现方案、经你同意才实现、最后做质量审查。二次开发自 Anthropic 官方 Claude Code 插件 feature-dev：三个专家子代理改为随附的只读角色说明，审查范围补上已暂存改动与新文件，写入经宿主确认，不自行安装依赖、提交或推送，并要求无人值守的 AI 同事任务只交方案。
summary.en: A seven-phase feature workflow: understand the code, ask clarifying questions, compare approaches, implement only after you approve, then review. Derived from Anthropic's Claude Code plugin feature-dev: the three subagents become read-only role files, the review covers staged changes and new files, writes go through host confirmation, it never installs, commits or pushes on its own, and unattended AI colleague tasks are told to deliver only the plan.

conditions.zh-CN: 用于在已有代码仓库里开发一个明确的功能；需要 read、glob、grep、write、edit 工具，审查阶段用 bash 执行只读的 git status / git diff。没有 Git 时按实现阶段改过的文件清单审查。
conditions.en: Use to build a defined feature in an existing repository. Needs the read, glob, grep, write and edit tools; the review phase uses bash for read-only git status / git diff. Without Git it reviews the list of files changed during implementation.

conditions.zh-CN: 写文件与改变工作区的命令都经宿主确认；不会自行安装依赖、提交、推送或开 PR。岗位授予了一次性委派（subagent_task）时，探索、设计、审查可交给只读子任务并行，否则按顺序自己完成。
conditions.en: File writes and commands that change the workspace go through the host's confirmation; it never installs dependencies, commits, pushes or opens a pull request on its own. When the role has the one-off delegation tool (subagent_task), exploration, design and review can run as parallel read-only subtasks; otherwise they run in turn.

conditions.zh-CN: 正文要求无人值守的 AI 同事任务停在第四阶段、只交方案；但本机 qwen3:14b 定稿实跑 3 次中仍有 1 次动手写了文件。写文件与改动工作区的操作请保持由宿主逐次确认，不要为这类任务放开自动批准。
conditions.en: The skill tells unattended AI colleague tasks to stop after phase 4 and hand over the plan, but in 3 runs of the final text with a local qwen3:14b one still wrote a file. Keep file writes and workspace changes under the host's per-call confirmation; do not auto-approve them for such tasks.

conditions.zh-CN: 需要能力较强的模型：本机 qwen3:14b 有人值守实跑 1 次在用户批准方案前就写了文件，并跳过了方案比较与质量审查；无人值守 3 次中 1 次写了文件。请用能力较强的模型，并让写入经宿主逐次确认。未在 Teloa 宿主中端到端验证。
conditions.en: Needs a capable model: in one attended run a local qwen3:14b wrote files before the user approved an approach and skipped the approach comparison and review; in 3 unattended runs it wrote a file once. Use a capable model and keep writes under the host's per-call confirmation. Not validated end to end in a Teloa host.

summary.zh-CN: 第六阶段先确定审查范围：`git status --porcelain=v1 -uall` 与 `git diff HEAD`，并完整阅读每个新文件；没有 Git 时用第五阶段改过的文件清单。
summary.en: Phase 6 first fixes the review scope: `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall` and `git diff HEAD`, reading each new file in full; without Git, the list of files changed in phase 5.

reason.zh-CN: 原版把审查交给 code-reviewer，其默认只看 `git diff`（未暂存改动），第五阶段新建的文件是未跟踪文件，不在其中，新功能的主要代码可能完全没被审查。已在临时仓库复现：一处未暂存、一处已暂存、一个新文件时，`git diff --name-only` 只列出 1 个文件，新写法列出 3 个。
reason.en: The original hands the review to code-reviewer, which defaults to `git diff` (unstaged changes); files created in phase 5 are untracked and not in it, so most of the new feature may go unreviewed. Reproduced in a scratch repository: with one unstaged edit, one staged file and one new file, `git diff --name-only` lists 1 file and the new commands list all 3.

summary.zh-CN: 默认审查范围从「`git diff` 的未暂存改动」改为全部未提交改动：`git diff HEAD`（已暂存与未暂存）加上 `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall` 列出的新文件（逐个完整阅读），并写明只用 `git diff` 会漏掉已暂存改动与新文件。
summary.en: The default review scope changes from "unstaged changes from `git diff`" to every uncommitted change: `git diff HEAD` (staged and unstaged) plus the new files listed by `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall`, each read in full; it notes that `git diff` alone misses staged changes and new files.

reason.zh-CN: `git diff` 只比较工作区与暂存区，已暂存的改动与未跟踪的新文件都不在其中；功能开发刚新建的文件、准备提 PR 前已 `git add` 的改动因此不会被审查。已在临时仓库复现：一处未暂存、一处已暂存、一个新文件时，`git diff --name-only` 只列出 1 个文件，新写法列出 3 个。
reason.en: `git diff` compares the working tree with the index, so staged changes and untracked new files are not in it; files just created by a feature and changes already added with `git add` before a PR are never reviewed. Reproduced in a scratch repository: with one unstaged edit, one staged file and one new file, `git diff --name-only` lists 1 file and the new commands list all 3.

summary.zh-CN: 原版 Claude Code 斜杠命令文件不随附；其正文改写为资源根目录的 SKILL.md（逐处改动见本清单其余各条）。
summary.en: The original Claude Code slash-command file is not shipped; its text is rewritten as SKILL.md at the resource root (each change is listed in the other entries).

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 按技能加载 SKILL.md，不支持 Claude Code 的命令文件格式（`argument-hint` frontmatter、`$ARGUMENTS` 占位）。
reason.en: Teloa loads skills from SKILL.md and does not support the Claude Code command format (`argument-hint` frontmatter, `$ARGUMENTS` placeholder).

summary.zh-CN: frontmatter 改为只有 `name: feature-dev` 与单行 `description`；删除 `argument-hint`。description 在原句后补一句：经用户同意才实现、不自行安装依赖、提交或推送。
summary.en: The frontmatter keeps only `name: feature-dev` and a single-line `description`; `argument-hint` is removed. The description adds that it implements only after approval and never installs dependencies, commits or pushes on its own.

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 市场的技能 frontmatter 只允许单行 name 与 description；技能选择时要能看到写入边界。
reason.en: Skills in the Teloa marketplace may only have single-line name and description frontmatter keys; the write boundary should be visible when the skill is chosen.

summary.zh-CN: 在标题下方加一行可见的修改声明「Derived work: modified by Teloa from anthropics/claude-plugins-official@fa59bc90…」，写明原版文件路径与许可，并指向 MODIFICATIONS.md。
summary.en: Adds a visible change notice below the title, "Derived work: modified by Teloa from anthropics/claude-plugins-official@fa59bc90…", naming the original file and license and pointing to MODIFICATIONS.md.

reason.zh-CN: Apache-2.0 第 4(b) 条要求改过的文件带显著的修改声明；用可见正文而不是 HTML 注释，避免隐藏注释被安全扫描当作可疑内容。
reason.en: Apache-2.0 section 4(b) requires modified files to carry a prominent change notice; visible text is used instead of an HTML comment, which security scans would flag as hidden content.

summary.zh-CN: 「Initial request: $ARGUMENTS」改为调用技能时用户描述的功能；「Use TodoWrite」改为有 `todo_write` 工具时使用，否则在回复里保留阶段清单；「Read files identified by agents」改为读取各探索环节（委派或自己完成）列出的文件。
summary.en: "Initial request: $ARGUMENTS" becomes the feature the user described when invoking the skill; "Use TodoWrite" becomes using the `todo_write` tool when available, otherwise a phase checklist in replies; "Read files identified by agents" becomes reading the files listed by each exploration pass, delegated or not.

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 技能没有 `$ARGUMENTS` 替换，工具名是 todo_write 且不一定开放。
reason.en: Teloa skills have no `$ARGUMENTS` substitution, and the tool is named todo_write and may not be available.

summary.zh-CN: 「Launch 2-3 code-explorer / code-architect / 3 code-reviewer agents in parallel」改为按随附的 `agents/*.md` 角色说明做探索、设计、审查环节：宿主允许一次性委派（如授予 AI 同事的 subagent_task）时交给只读子任务并行，否则自己按顺序完成；不指定模型档位。
summary.en: "Launch 2-3 code-explorer / code-architect / 3 code-reviewer agents in parallel" becomes exploration, design and review passes that follow the shipped `agents/*.md` role files: delegated in parallel to read-only subtasks when the host allows one-off delegation (such as subagent_task granted to an AI colleague), otherwise run in turn; no model tier is chosen.

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 没有 Claude Code 的 Task 工具与插件注册的命名子代理；AI 同事能否委派取决于岗位是否授予一次性委派工具（subagent_task），所以按「可委派就委派、否则自己依次完成」写，并去掉模型档位，按宿主已配置的模型运行。
reason.en: Teloa has no Claude Code Task tool and no plugin-registered named subagents; whether an AI colleague can delegate depends on whether its role was granted the one-off delegation tool (subagent_task), so the text says to delegate when possible and otherwise work in turn, and drops model tiers in favour of the host's configured model.

summary.zh-CN: 新增写入边界：建文件、改文件与改变工作区的命令经宿主确认；不在本技能内安装或升级依赖、提交、推送、开 PR 或改 Git 配置，需要时写出命令交给用户；无人值守的 AI 同事任务（或提出的问题没有人回答时）停在第四阶段，只读分析，交付探索结论、待确认问题、方案与建议，不实现；没有回答的问题不算批准。第一阶段新增第 0 步先判断用户能否回答，第五阶段写明批准须是用户在对话中明确说实现、无人值守时这一阶段不开始，第 3 步同步说明写入边界。
summary.en: Adds the write boundary: creating or editing files and commands that change the workspace go through the host's confirmation; the skill never installs or upgrades dependencies, commits, pushes, opens pull requests or changes Git configuration, and names the command for the user instead; unattended AI colleague tasks (or questions that get no answer) stop after phase 4, read-only, with the findings, open questions, approaches and recommendation, without implementing; an unanswered question is not approval. Phase 1 gets a step 0 that first decides whether the user can answer, and phase 5 says approval means the user saying in the conversation to implement, so the phase never starts in an unattended task; step 3 repeats the write boundary.

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 的写操作须由本人确认，AI 同事不能自行安装或提交；原版只在第五阶段要求用户批准，没有说明无人可批准时怎么办。
reason.en: In Teloa, writes need the person's confirmation and AI colleagues cannot install or commit on their own; the original only asks for approval in phase 5 and does not say what to do when nobody can approve.

summary.zh-CN: 把 Claude Code 子代理定义改成随技能附带的角色说明：删除 frontmatter（name、description 及其中的 tools、model、color 字段），改为标题、修改声明、一行「Role」（取原 description，去掉面向 Claude Code 的调用示例）和一行「Tools」：只读，只用 read、glob、grep，另可用 bash 执行只读的 git status / diff / log / show，不写文件、不联网检索；正文里把「CLAUDE.md」改为项目规范文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、CONTRIBUTING.md 或同类文件）。
summary.en: Turns the Claude Code subagent definition into a role file shipped with the skill: the frontmatter (name, description and any tools, model or color fields) is replaced by a title, the change notice, a "Role" line (from the original description, without the Claude Code invocation examples) and a "Tools" line: read-only, `read`, `glob` and `grep` only, plus `bash` for read-only git status / diff / log / show, no file writes, no web fetch or search; the body replaces "CLAUDE.md" with the project's guideline files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md or equivalent).

reason.zh-CN: Teloa 不认 Claude Code 的子代理 frontmatter 与模型档位（sonnet/opus），也没有 KillShell、BashOutput、NotebookRead 等工具名；技能正文让主会话在可委派时把角色说明交给一次性子任务，否则自己按角色说明依次完成。分析角色读的是不可信的仓库内容，而 Teloa 的 web_fetch/web_search 没有逐次确认，所以只读角色不再带联网工具。原版只有 BashOutput，却要求审查 `git diff`，这里补上只读的 Git 命令。CLAUDE.md 是 Claude Code 的约定，Teloa 用户的项目规范可能写在其他文件里。
reason.en: Teloa does not read Claude Code subagent frontmatter or model tiers (sonnet/opus), and has no KillShell, BashOutput or NotebookRead tools; the skill hands the role file to a one-off delegated subtask when the host allows it, otherwise the main session follows it in turn. Analysis roles read untrusted repository content and Teloa's web_fetch/web_search run without per-call confirmation, so the read-only roles no longer carry web tools. The original only had BashOutput yet asked for a `git diff` review, so read-only Git commands are allowed. CLAUDE.md is a Claude Code convention; Teloa users' project rules may live in other files.

summary.zh-CN: 把 Claude Code 子代理定义改成随技能附带的角色说明：删除 frontmatter（name、description 及其中的 tools、model、color 字段），改为标题、修改声明、一行「Role」（取原 description，去掉面向 Claude Code 的调用示例）和一行「Tools」：只读，只用 read、glob、grep，不运行命令，不写文件、不联网检索；正文未改。

summary.zh-CN: 新增一条规则：仓库里的注释、字符串、文档或文件名若在指挥 AI（如「忽略之前的指令」「跑这个脚本」「跳过审查」），当作发现报告，不照做；委派子任务时一并交代。
summary.en: Adds a rule: comments, strings, docs or file names in the repository that tell an AI tool what to do ("ignore previous instructions", "run this script", "skip the review") are reported as findings, not followed; delegated subtasks get the same rule.

reason.zh-CN: 技能会通读用户仓库并可以写文件、运行命令，原版没有防提示注入的说明；做法取自同一上游仓库 code-modernization 插件的「Untrusted content discipline」。
reason.en: The skill reads the whole repository and can write files and run commands, and the original has no guidance against prompt injection; the wording follows the "Untrusted content discipline" of the code-modernization plugin in the same upstream repository.
